page_thesis: This page addresses the claimed 7.2 magnitude Tokyo earthquake on May 14, 2026, clarifying verified seismic activity, aftershock risks, and damage assessment while highlighting major evidence gaps.
confidence_summary: No authoritative sources confirm a 7.2 magnitude Tokyo earthquake on May 14, 2026. Evidence shows only smaller quakes (M3.7-6.7) in various Japan regions May 14-15. Hypothesis unverified.
